High quality food with generous servings. A must-try in Saigon!
Aug 2023 • Solo
The Hype Eatery & More is a hidden gem located in District 1 of Saigon. The All You Can Eat Buffet is really affordable for the quality of food that you receive. The food itself is delicious and the service is great. Not to mention the generous serving size of each dish. I would definitely visit here again in the future!
